changes.change: Modified sudden death postseason: opening TD can end game; opening FG allows response.
changes.simulator_implication: Select 2010-2011 postseason regime; do not apply to 2010-2011 REG.

changes.change: Regular season continues pre-2012 sudden-death overtime.
changes.simulator_implication: Do not apply modified-sudden-death REG rules to this era.

changes.change: Defensive alignment protection near snapper on field goals, punts, try kicks.
changes.simulator_implication: Penalty/blocked kick defense cannot sample pre-rule illegal formation as legal.

changes.change: Kickoff line moved from own 30 to own 35; coverage team running start reduced.
changes.simulator_implication: Separate return/touchback pools for 2010 and 2011 onward; dynamic kickoff supersedes in 2024.

changes.change: Regular-season overtime switches to modified sudden death, 15-minute maximum.
changes.simulator_implication: First-possession FG grants an answering opportunity, opening TD can end game.

changes.change: Tuck rule eliminated: certain QB loses ball while returning it to body are fumbles.
changes.simulator_implication: Do not back-label 2010-2012 borderline QB incidents using new regime.

changes.change: Limits overload defense on field-goal and try kick formations.
changes.simulator_implication: Change legality for historical blocked-kick and kicking-formation samples.

changes.change: Outside final two minutes of each half, clock stays running after a quarterback sack.
changes.simulator_implication: Calibrate sack runoff with clock rules by era; audit later amendments.

changes.change: Recovery of a loose ball in field of play becomes reviewable.
changes.simulator_implication: Affects overturned recovery sequences; don't treat review changes as raw fumble rate.

changes.change: One-point kick moved to 15-yard-line snap; two-point try remains at 2-yard line.
changes.simulator_implication: Segment extra-point make rate and post-TD choice before/after 2015.

changes.change: Defense may score two points by returning a failed try.
changes.simulator_implication: Support defensive conversion return transitions only in eras where legal.

changes.change: Kickoff touchback moves from 20 to 25-yard line (trial then retained).
changes.simulator_implication: Use kickoff touchback start spot per season; not uniform for 2010–2026.

changes.change: Chop blocks prohibited across the board.
changes.simulator_implication: Era-dependent penalty legality, player safety distributions.

changes.change: Regular-season overtime maximum shortened to 10 minutes.
changes.simulator_implication: Do not borrow 15-minute overtime runoff/end-of-game logic.

changes.change: Leaping blocks on field goals and PATs prohibited.
changes.simulator_implication: Blocked-kick model historical stratification/control for rule changes.

changes.change: Updated legal catch standard.
changes.simulator_implication: Flag catch/interception/replay labels as era-sensitive.

changes.change: Kickoff formation and blocking changed for 2018, later made permanent in 2019.
changes.simulator_implication: Separate 2011–2017 kickoff mechanics from 2018–2023.

changes.change: A meaningless try after a touchdown at end of regulation is no longer required.
changes.simulator_implication: Do not impute observed missing try as missed; determine whether try can affect result.

changes.change: Second-team turnover down after first-team opening FG runs to completion, including return points.
changes.simulator_implication: Apply Article 5(a) continuations, accounting for subsequent OT regime.

changes.change: Pass interference calls and noncalls were reviewable for 2019 season only.
changes.simulator_implication: Isolate 2019 challenge outcome/penalty enforcement; don't pool with nonreview years.

changes.change: 2018 kickoff blocking/formation trial made permanent.
changes.simulator_implication: Same family of pre-dynamic kickoffs; preserve 2018 trial metadata.

changes.change: 2019 pass-interference replay provision expired and was not renewed.
changes.simulator_implication: Don't simulate pass interference review as available after 2019.

changes.change: Expanded defenseless-player protections for kick and punt returners.
changes.simulator_implication: Era-dependent kick return penalties and possession consequences.

changes.change: Schedule moved to 17 games over 18 weeks, from 16 games in 17 weeks.
changes.simulator_implication: Normalize per-game and per-week statistics and remaining-games/stakes calculations.

changes.change: No overtime in preseason.
changes.simulator_implication: Exclude PRE from REG/POST OT pool and treat preseason separately.

changes.change: Expanded officials' provision of certain objective information.
changes.simulator_implication: Track changing replay capabilities instead of treating all interventions as same.

changes.change: Each team gets opportunity to possess ball in postseason overtime even after first-possession TD.
changes.simulator_implication: Separate 2022+ POST from REG; retain postseason multi-period rules.

changes.change: One-year provision: fair catch of free kick behind receiving 25 placed at 25.
changes.simulator_implication: Use 2023-specific kickoff and safety-kick fair-catch transitions.

changes.change: Dynamic kickoff introduced with landing/setup zones and altered movement.
changes.simulator_implication: Use era-specific kick pool and legal spatial/return outcomes; 2024 TB can be 20 or 30 per kick path.

changes.change: Swivel hip-drop tackle prohibited.
changes.simulator_implication: Era-sensitive tackles, penalties, potential participation injuries.

changes.change: Dynamic kickoff era onside declaration limited to trailing team in fourth quarter.
changes.simulator_implication: Do not use pre-2024 or post-2024 onside eligibility rules blindly.

changes.change: Dynamic kickoff retained, modified setup alignment and touchback to 35 for specified end-zone touchbacks.
changes.simulator_implication: Use 2025+ touchback rules by kick path; no generic 2022–2025 kickoff sampling.

changes.change: Regular-season OT gives both clubs possession opportunity even after opening TD, still one 10-minute period.
changes.simulator_implication: Cannot treat historical REG 2022–24 first-possession walk-off TD as ending 2025+ OT.

changes.change: Trailing clubs allowed to declare onside kick at any time during game under dynamic rules.
changes.simulator_implication: Separate from 2024 fourth-quarter-only declaration.

changes.change: Replay assist expands for objective clear-and-obvious errors and administration.
changes.simulator_implication: Version replay corrections independently of core on-field events.

changes.change: Special touchback spot rule when kicking off from the 50-yard line.
changes.simulator_implication: Apply source-specific kickoff-from-50 field-position rule; verify text before implementing exact spot.

changes.change: Receiving team setup-zone alignment modified.
changes.simulator_implication: Update legal kick alignment for 2026.

changes.change: 2026 official Rule 6-1-6 explicitly allows trailing team to declare onside at any time.
changes.simulator_implication: Consistent with 2025 summary; audit for actual semantic delta instead of double-counting intervention.

changes.change: League personnel consultation expanded for possible disqualification for flagrant acts.
changes.simulator_implication: Rule-era discipline/in-game available-player state; audit implementation scope.
